text:
deploy-bot: Rollout started: v1.16.3 -> prod (canary 5%). Rollout ID rl_z2k7. Runbook: ops.redwood/runbooks/postdeploy-quickcheck.

anita: Observed region divergence: synth agent in eu-west shows p95 spike for chat-route (p95 ~1.3s) while us-west steady (p95 ~420ms). No 5xxs.

tom: Could be region-specific capacity scheduling or kv-cache coldness. Is the model variant the same across regions?

anita: Yes, same variant. Traffic slice small (~1.2% in EU).

infra: We can apply a region-scoped soft-pin to route in eu-west only to revert to previous variant for 20m while we investigate. Command: 
```bash
redwoodctl route pin --route chat-route --model redwood-chat-v1.12 --region eu-west --duration 20m --reason "eu-west p95 spike postdeploy"
```

release-mgr: Prefer soft-pin over full rollback so other regions continue. If eu-west stabilizes after warmup, we'll unpin and proceed.

sre-oncall: Agree. Suppress p95 alert for this rollout window in eu-west; escalate on 5xx > 0.5%.

tom: Running a focused smoke against eu-west now:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://eu.api.redwood.test/v1/chat-route/smoke -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"prompt":"test"}' -w "TIME:%{time_total}s" -o /dev/null
```

tom: Pre-pin smoke (eu-west): TIME:1.28s

infra: Applying pin now.

deploy-bot: Action completed: route pin applied -> chat-route pinned to redwood-chat-v1.12 in eu-west for 20m by infra. Audit=aud_pin_3f.

anita: Re-ran smoke after pin (2m): TIME:0.45s looks back to baseline for sample.

release-mgr: I'll note in rollout artifacts: "eu-west soft-pin applied to chat-route for postdeploy p95 verification". Leave pin for 20m and monitor.

sre-oncall: Monitoring. If p99 > 1.5s or 5xx > 0.5% open rollback.

anita: Will post final status after 15m.
